name: IDA Pro MCP
description: Bridges IDA Pro to LLM clients over MCP, exposing decompilation, disassembly, cross-references, type and stack edits, memory reads and patching as callable tools.

skills.name: Decompile And Disassemble
skills.description: Returns Hex-Rays decompilation or full disassembly of a function, including arguments and stack frame layout, from a database.

skills.name: Annotate IDB
skills.description: Writes comments to disassembly and decompiler views, declares C types, defines functions, patches instructions and adds bookmarks.

skills.name: Cross-Reference Analysis
skills.description: Lists xrefs to addresses and struct fields, enumerates callees, imports, exports and globals to map control and data flow.

skills.name: Memory And Struct Reads
skills.description: Reads raw bytes, typed integers, strings and struct field values at addresses, and converts number bases with int_convert.

skills.name: Headless idalib Sessions
skills.description: Opens binaries in detached idalib workers over stdio, SSE or HTTP, managing several named database sessions side by side.
